Self-attention takes Q, K and V from one tensor. Cross-attention takes Q from one and K and V from another, and that is how Stable Diffusion's U-Net reads a text prompt while it denoises an image. Both inputs here are random stand-ins: query for 6 image positions, context for 4 prompt tokens, with the four projections fixed by seed 42 and never trained. After a run the heatmap on the Edu-CrossAttention node holds 2 panels, one per head, each 6 rows by 4 columns, every row summing to 1. The pack's C6-3 example gives the same node image patches as its query.

Self-attention 的 Q、K、V 都來自同一個張量；cross-attention 的 Q 來自一邊，K 和 V 來自另一邊 — Stable Diffusion 的 U-Net 就是這樣一邊去噪、一邊讀文字 prompt。這裡兩邊的輸入都是隨機的替代張量：query 代表 6 個影像位置，context 代表 4 個 prompt token，四組投影由 seed 42 固定，沒有訓練過。跑完之後，Edu-CrossAttention 節點上的熱圖會有 2 張，一個 head 一張，每張 6 列 4 欄，每一列加起來是 1。這個套件包的 C6-3 範例把影像切出來的 patch 當成同一個節點的 query。

Q is projected from query, K and V from context, so the two sides do not have to be the same length: the weights come out as heads by query rows by context rows. Nothing is connected to q_labels or k_labels, so the axes stay unnamed.

Q 由 query 投影，K 和 V 由 context 投影，所以兩邊的長度不必相同：權重的形狀是 head 數、query 列數、context 列數。q_labels 和 k_labels 都沒有接，所以座標軸上不會有名稱。

context is the K/V side, and its row count is free: make the shape 7,8 and the map becomes 6 by 7. The last number has to stay 8, because both sides must match embed_dim on the attention node.

context 是 K/V 那一邊，列數可以自由決定：把 shape 改成 7,8，圖就變成 6 列 7 欄。最後一個數字必須維持 8，因為兩邊都要和 attention 節點的 embed_dim 相同。
